name: open5gs-k8s
what_it_is: Kubernetes manifests for deploying Open5GS 5G core network (v2.7.0) as microservices with multi-slice support, Multus/OVS-CNI secondary networking, and UERANSIM simulated gNB and UEs. Also includes an all-in-one Docker Compose variant for single-container testing.
components: SMF (Session Management Function) — one instance per slice
UPF (User Plane Function) — one instance per slice
UERANSIM UE (simulated user equipment, 2 UEs by default)
protocols: SBI/HTTP2 (5G Service Based Interface between NFs via SCP)
measurement: Prometheus metrics exposed by AMF on port 9090 (address 0.0.0.0)
Optional Monarch integration (5g-monarch) for network slice monitoring via overlay `open5gs-metrics`
tcpdump on UPF ogstun TUN interface for GTP-U traffic inspection
kubectl logs per NF pod for real-time log access
configuration: Per-NF ConfigMaps (e.g., amf-configmap.yaml) holding YAML config files mounted at /open5gs/config/
Two S-NSSAIs by default: SST=1 SD=000001 and SST=2 SD=000002
Slice count configurable via msd/generate.py using data/config.yaml (multi-slice deployment generator)
UE IP pool per slice via SMF config (slice1: 10.41.0.0/16)
Subscriber data added via Open5GS WebUI or mongo-tools Python scripts (add-admin-account.py, CLI tools)
Kustomize-based overlays for standard, metrics, node-selector, and demo deployments
modes: All-in-one Docker Compose deployment (open5gs-aio/docker-compose.yaml) with DEBUG_MODE env var
Monarch monitoring overlay (msd/overlays/open5gs-metrics) for slice-level metrics
Multi-slice deployment via msd/ with configurable slice count and auto-generated manifests
COTS UE mode (add-cots-subscribers.sh) alongside simulated UERANSIM UEs
constraints: Requires Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Ubuntu 20.04 also supported); macOS and Windows users must provision an Ubuntu VM — Kubernetes manifests are not directly usable on macOS/Windows hosts
Requires Kubernetes v1.28 with Multus CNI and OVS-CNI pre-configured (via testbed-automator); OVS bridges n2, n3, n4 must exist before deployment
Minimum hardware: 2 vCPUs, 4 GB RAM, 40 GB disk; single-node or multi-node K8s both supported
Two SMF/UPF instances are deployed by default (one per slice); sharing NFs like AMF across slices is by design
srsRAN integration requires both AMF and gNB on n3network instead of n2network due to srsRAN constraints
docker_services: mongodb — mongo image, port 27017, persists data to named volume
open5gs-webui — ghcr.io/niloysh/open5gs-webui:v2.7.0, port 9999, depends on mongodb
open5gs-aio — ghcr.io/niloysh/open5gs:v2.7.0, all-in-one 5G core, ports 9090 (metrics) and 38412/sctp (NGAP), privileged, multi-homed on n2/n3/n4 bridge networks
notable_absences: No fault injection or chaos tooling included
No built-in traffic generation beyond UERANSIM ping tests (no iPerf, no load profiles)
No pre-built Grafana dashboards in the repo (Monarch integration is external)
No automated test suite or CI pipeline in the repository
UERANSIM UE count defaults to 2; scaling requires manual manifest duplication or msd generator
